newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 5.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 5. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto's eldest daughter Siti Hardiyanti Rukmana said there was no such thing as a Suharto family dynasty.
A witch doctor or traditional healer in north Sumatra has admitted to murdering 42 women in a series of recent killings.

Surjadi, leader of the government-recognised faction of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), was the subject of a demonstration by supporters of the ousted leader Megawati Sukarnoputri in the East Java town of Jember when he campaigned on Java for the first time on Sunday.

Jakarta military commader Major-General Sutiyoso has promised firm action against political parties that do not stop their supporters from conducting illegal street parades during the current election campaign.
Inefficient road and rail transport has meant that there is a backlog of 3,000 containers at Jakarta's Tanjung Priok port.
